About Us

Innovation with precision

Advik Biotech Lab, one of the leading biotech labs in Greater Noida, was established in 2020 by a group of young and highly educated professionals with a passion for innovation. We are ISO certified, reflecting our commitment to quality, precision and international standards.

Our focus includes skill enhancement through a training lab in Noida, experimental testing of samples from the contractual sector, molecular diagnostics and the development of research kits.

Our method turns trainees from raw talent into skilled personnel, improving their internship opportunities.

Vision, mission & objectives

What drives the lab and the people we train.

Vision

Ushering competent aspirants to employ premium processes and applications that can profoundly influence existing paradigm of agriculture, industry, healthcare and restoration of environment. It can provide sustainable competitive edge to the present society through biotechnological interventions.

Mission

  1. Instil spirit of innovative researcher in young minds with sound research aptitude.
  2. Nurture innovative researchers who can be effective contributors in developing biotechnological processes to benefit all sections of the society.
  3. Promote entrepreneurship in biotechnology-based industry.

Objectives

  1. Develop the basic and advanced (industry oriented) laboratory techniques of a biotechnology/bioscience lab.
  2. Enrich theoretical knowledge with hands-on practical tools.
  3. Develop scientific temper.
  4. Encourage teamwork so as to learn the responsibility of any research lab and industry.
  5. Develop multitasking skills.

Program overview

  • ADVIK BIOTECH is a bioservices laboratory that can provide services and training in Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Industrial Microbiology, Plant Tissue culture, Computational Biology, Bio-informatics and Agro-informatics.
  • All the modules are industrially designed as per the requirements of the Biotech sector.
  • A Training Certificate (approved) will be issued with grades after successful completion of training program.
